subject: Dashboards + Tracing composite SKU and projected savings
messages:
From: Susan Miller <susan@acme.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Richards <tom.richards@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry add-ons — dashboards + tracing pricing ask

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the team liked the advanced dashboards and the tracing samples. We’re trying to model annual cost against our expected ingest spikes and retention mix. A couple of asks before we take this to procurement:

- Can you provide a bundled SKU that combines 90-day trace retention, advanced dashboards (30 seats), and the sampling credits?
- What discount bands do you offer for committed annual spend vs. month-to-month?
- Any concessions you can offer on ingress egress chargebacks for the first 3 months while we ramp?

We’re aiming to finalize by end of the month if the economics work — would appreciate a clean quote and a sample SOW/contract redline. Attaching our internal usage projection (sent separately).

Best,
Susan
Director of Platform Engineering
Acme AI

[Attachment: usage-projections.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Susan Miller <susan@acme.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — dashboards + tracing pricing ask

Hi Susan — thanks for the clear asks and the projection file. Looping in Kimberly and Jordan to confirm commercial options.

Quick notes from product/ops standpoint:
- We can offer a composite "Telemetry Plus" SKU that bundles: 90-day trace retention (sampled at 5% adaptive), 30 advanced dashboard seats, and 1M sampling credits per month. The SKU can scale with a simple multiplier for additional seats or credits.
- Baseline per-month list price for the composite bundle is attached (quote-AcmeAI-v2.pdf).

Commercial questions for procurement:
- Are you looking for a 12-month committed consumption model or a 24-month reserved capacity with monthly true-ups? Reserved is where the most meaningful discounts sit.
- Can you confirm expected average tokens/trace volume (you included spikes; helpful to see baseline too)?

I’ll ask Kimberly to draft a discount path and an initial SOW. We can also carve out ingress waiver for first 90 days as a limited ramp concession — Kimber, can you confirm?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: quote-AcmeAI-v2.pdf (proposal)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Susan Miller <susan@acme.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — dashboards + tracing pricing ask

Hi team — thanks Naomi. Susan — based on the projection and the ask for a quick procurement path, here’s a pragmatic commercial framework we can present:

1) 12-month committed Telemetry Plus (composite SKU) — 15% off list for commit >= $150k ARR.
2) 24-month committed — 22% off list plus one-time migration credit equal to 5% of first-year ARR (applied to billing).
3) Ramp concession: waive ingress egress up to 10TB for first 90 days for customers that sign a 12+ month commit.
4) If Acme prefers month-to-month, list prices apply; we can provide a consumption credits package but no ingress waiver.

I’ve attached a draft SOW template and a redline-friendly contract (redline_CorpTerms.docx) — feel free to mark changes.

Action items: Naomi, can you run forecasting scenarios for the 12 vs 24-month paths (simple NPV of expected spend + discount) and share by EOD tomorrow? Susan, if you can confirm target spend band, we’ll tailor the discount band.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: SOW-telemetry.xlsx, redline_CorpTerms.docx]

From: Susan Miller <susan@acme.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Richards <tom.richards@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — dashboards + tracing pricing ask

Thanks Kimberly — that structure is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement:

- We’re leaning to a 12-month commit but would need the ingress waiver to cover expected onboarding (that 10TB should be enough).
- Can the migration credit be front-loaded as a one-time invoice credit rather than a billing amortization? Procurement tends to prefer that for bookkeeping.
- We will need SOC 2 evidence and a short data-retention summary that we can attach to our security questionnaire.

Tom and I will review the SOW and redline the contract — can you provide a DocuSign-ready version once we have minor redlines? Also confirm the SLA for dashboards (queries per minute per seat) — product mentioned "dashboard optimized queries" but procurement wants a number to include in the contract.

Best,
Susan

[Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Susan Miller <susan@acme.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — dashboards + tracing pricing ask

Hi Susan — Jordan from Solutions. Quick answers to product/procurement items: 

- SLA: Dashboard query SLA for the Telemetry Plus bundle is 95th percentile < 250ms for pre-aggregated dashboards and < 800ms for ad-hoc queries up to 5 QPM per seat. We can negotiate higher QPM if you require it as part of the SLA with an associated throughput uplift.
- SOC 2 evidence: Naomi, I uploaded the SOC 2 Type II package and the redacted control narrative to the deal folder (link below). Susan, I’ll email the checklist items to your security contact and include a short retention summary (90-day trace retention by default; archival options available).
- Contract flow: we can provide a DocuSign-ready package once your redlines are in; migration credit can be structured as a one-time invoice credit — Kimberly will confirm the accounting treatment but that's doable.

Links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-telemetry-sow (SOW)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DEAL-ACME-5621

We’ll prepare a clean quote with the 12-month commit discount and the 90-day ingress waiver for you to review by EOD Thursday.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
